intuition: The best path to a cell comes from the cheaper of the cell above and the cell to its left.

brute_force.approach: Recursively enumerate every right-and-down path to the bottom-right cell.

optimal.approach: Maintain one DP row, combining the saved value from above with the updated value from the left.

edge_cases: A one-cell grid returns its cell value.
Single-row and single-column grids have only one path.
Initialize the first row and column by cumulative sums.
